title: Alias Part: Give Content Items a Stable Name | Orchard Core
description:
A content item ID is generated, and it can differ from one site to another, so a menu or a template that moves between sites cannot rely on it.

The Alias part gives a content item a name that you choose, stored with the item. This video adds the part to the Article content type of a site made with the Blog recipe, generates and keeps aliases, shows the rules that aliases follow, and ends with the alias of the main menu.

In this video:
• Why a content item needs an alias
• Checking that the Alias feature is enabled
• Adding the Alias part to a content type
• Generating an alias from the title, keeping it, and generating it again
• Typing an alias, and why each alias belongs to one content item
• The generated and disabled option
• The rules of an alias: uniqueness, length and case
• The alias of the main menu at work
